headings.text: Two teams, two layers of the stack: models on one side, the software that ships them on the other.
Three parts of one job: decide with the model, build the product around it, and show what the data can support.
I studied CSE (AI/ML) at Galgotias, built an AI stylist at Merorr, and now build Spring Boot and Angular systems at Capgemini.
